item.description:
whoami

Niels. Cloud & DevOps Engineer with 12+ years in IT.

Started in user-focused support, moved through complex on-prem environments, and have been pushing toward cloud-native infrastructure ever since. That background means I understand why legacy systems are built the way they are — and how to modernise them without breaking everything.

Currently focused on designing and automating secure, resilient infrastructure in the Microsoft Azure ecosystem. Calm and analytical when things get complex. Mission: bridge the gap between innovative technology and robust, secure operations.
